name: Tesla Rubric
description: Evaluation rubric for used Tesla vehicles (Model X focus). Score is the sum of points from each criterion; total maps to a verdict band.

scoringAlgorithm.summary: For each criterion, compute points from the selection value; sum all points and round to 1 decimal. Then find the score band by comparing total to minScore (use the band with the highest minScore that is <= total; null minScore means no lower bound).

rules.select: Find the option where option.value === selection; add option.points.
rules.boolean: If selection === true, add basePoints; else add 0.
rules.conditional_boolean: If selection === true, add basePoints; if selections[conditionalPoints.when] === conditionalPoints.equals, add conditionalPoints.bonus as well.
rules.price: points = -((price - basePrice) / 1000) * |pointsPerThousand|. (e.g. $45k with base $40k and -1 per $1k => -5 points.)
rules.range_score: Find the threshold where selection <= threshold.max (use null for Infinity); add that threshold.points.

scoringAlgorithm.inputSchema: Selections object: keys = criterion id, value = string (select/price/range_score) or boolean (boolean/conditional_boolean). Omit criteria to skip (no points).
